author: ETA PRIME
description:
The ASUS Googlebook 14 has a gorgeous 120Hz 3K OLED display and premium hardware—but can it run the apps and games you actually use? After 72 hours with Googlebook OS, app compatibility is my biggest concern.

In this hands-on first look, I explore Google’s new Android-based laptop experience, compare performance with my Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra, and test Android gaming, cloud gaming, and emulation.

We’re checking out Diablo Immortal, Asphalt, GeForce NOW, Steam Link, PSP emulation with PPSSPP, and GameCube emulation with Dolphin. There are some impressive results—but missing apps, crashes, and gaming limitations raise a bigger question: who is this laptop actually for?

Would you choose a Googlebook over a Windows laptop—or stick with your phone and Samsung DeX? Let me know below. Want a full emulation test or a one-month follow-up? Tell me which one!
